skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and evaluate information security threats and countermeasures, manage risks, and protect information on networks and systems.
Understand and apply symmetric and asymmetric encryption techniques, including key exchange methods and digital signatures.
Apply mathematical concepts to cryptographic algorithms and protocols.
Implement cryptographic algorithms and protocols using programming languages.
Analyze and solve problems related to cryptography and information security.
Conduct research and develop cryptographic systems and digital signatures.
Work effectively in teams and independently, demonstrating responsibility and ethical conduct.
Evaluate and analyze cryptographic systems and information security measures.
Manage and present group projects related to cryptographic systems and digital signatures.
